figurative_meaning_en: to rest or take a break
example_sentences_in_bangla: অনেক পরিশ্রমের পর একটু দম নাও।
দৌড়ানো শেষ করে সে একটু দম নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: After a lot of hard work, take a rest now.
After finishing the run, he took a moment to catch his breath.
note: This idiom is derived from the physical act of breathing, commonly used in everyday Bengali speech to indicate a pause for recovery.
